title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in VillaTheme Catna…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in VillaTheme Catna – Woo Name Your Price and Offers plugin versions up to 2.0.3. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
